Lo-fi album v1.1-music

The first row is the reference, today's music. The four new pieces are its lo-fi siblings. Press Play, or A/B to compare with the reference. Calm, Flow and Urgent are the three intensity levels.

    Lift beat: every new piece runs at 87.8 bpm, one Lift every two beats (1.367 s, the time a Lift takes to return you to your take-off height). The kick plays on every Lift beat at every level; Show Lift beats flashes it. When a flight starts or resumes, the music shifts its beat by at most 6% over two bars to meet the Lift guide. How the game uses it: map, Rest and pause play Calm (pause also turns the music down); flight plays Flow; a Guardian, the last heart, low Sparks, a near Black Hole or Flash play Urgent. Changes land on a bar line and fade over 1 to 3 seconds; falls wait 6 seconds. Each piece hands over to the next over about 8 seconds, on the beat. In the game this is off unless the address ends in ?music=2.
